|translation='''Title:''' Wookiee Roar.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use when Chewbacca is defending a battle alone at a specific location card. You may add two battle destiny.

2: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck for Chewbacca and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace.

3: Threaten (lose) one "mouse" droid on table.

'''Lore:'''
If Chewbacca's roar rebukes them, even a mouse droid flees that spot at once.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore describes Chewbacca's roar scattering a mouse droid; English lore is only the roar onomatopoeia.
